notes: Blood-establishment CGMP letter (Fenwal International/Fresenius Kabi) for terminally-sterilized blood-collection products: chronic failure to investigate TNTC bioburden and swarming-organism excursions, invalid sterility-assurance-level calculations, and facility/equipment contamination findings. Organisms recovered in the facility (Staphylococcus saprophyticus, Acinetobacter baumanni) were genetically matched to isolates from clinical septic-transfusion-reaction cases, so linked_to_complaints is true. No FEI number and no recall are stated in the letter; issuing_office is given as published since the signing division is not one of the standard center acronyms.

expected.issuing_office: Division of Biological Products Operations I
